Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Ser referência técnica em Segurança da Informação e Proteção de Dados, atuando como facilitador e orientador para a equipe e demais áreas da organização.
  • Criar, revisar e manter políticas, normas e diretrizes de Segurança da Informação que assegurem o adequado gerenciamento das informações da CCEE, alinhados as melhores práticas e regulamentações
  • Garantir a confidencialidade, integridade, disponibilidade e autenticidade das informações da empresa, apoiando áreas de negócio, produtos e projetos.
  • Analisar riscos e atuar de forma proativa na prevenção de fraudes, vazamentos e perdas de dados, por meio de normativos, controles técnicos e ações de conscientização.
  • Antecipar possíveis ameaças oriundas de novos negócios, aquisições e parcerias, propondo mitigadores e barreiras de segurança.
  • Gerenciar o ciclo de Identidade e Acesso (IAM), assegurando que apenas usuários autorizados acessem sistemas e dados através de Matriz RBAC (Controle de Acesso Baseado em Papéis).
  • Estabelecer uma cultura organizacional de segurança, promovendo treinamentos, webinars, campanhas, conteúdos gamificados e ações contínuas de engajamento.
  • Atuar como guardião dos requisitos de segurança, avaliando e reportando à alta direção os indicadores e conformidades através de dashboards e relatórios estruturados.
  • Apoiar ativamente as iniciativas e demandas da área de Privacidade de Dados (LGPD).
  • Liderar a estruturação e manutenção do Programa de Continuidade de Negócios, garantindo capacidade de resposta a incidentes de segurança de forma eficaz.
  • Acompanhar e avaliar tecnicamente fornecedores especializados em segurança (pentest, SAST, DAST, etc.), incluindo a definição de requisitos para contratação além de validar a aderência dos relatórios e recomendações recebidas.
  • Promover o desenvolvimento técnico da equipe, compartilhando conhecimento, boas práticas e liderando tecnicamente em temas críticos.
  • Manter-se atualizado com tendências, ameaças e novas soluções em segurança da informação, propondo inovações tecnológicas para evolução contínua do ambiente corporativo.
  • Apoiar a gestão em definições orçamentárias, apresentando as necessidades de novas ferramentas, atualizações de software, treinamentos, serviços de consultoria, etc., com justificativas claras e dados de suporte, bem como apoiar na definição de priorização e sazonalização dos gastos no decorrer do ano.

Requisitos e qualificações
  • Graduação em Análise de Sistemas, Engenharia de Computação, Engenharia de Telecomunicações, Engenharia de TI ou áreas correlatas.
  • Pós-graduação ou especialização em Segurança da Informação, Cibersegurança, Engenharia de Redes ou áreas similares.

Experiência Profissional:
  • Sólida experiência em Segurança da Informação.
  • Experiência em ambientes regulados e de missão crítica.
  • Atuação anterior com definição de políticas, prevenção a fraudes, resposta a incidentes, IAM e cultura organizacional de segurança.
  • Vivência com contratação, análise e validação técnica de fornecedores de testes de segurança (pentest, consultorias, etc.).
  • Conhecimento e aplicação prática de frameworks como ISO 27001, NIST e CIS Controls.

Conhecimentos Técnicos:
  • Fundamentais: ISO/IEC 27001, NIST, LGPD, CIS Controls.
  • Ferramentas: EDR (Endpoint Detection and Response), DLP (Data Loss Prevention), IAM (Identity and Access Management), SIEM, ferramentas de análise de vulnerabilidade (Tenable, Nessus, Qualys), sistemas de proteção contra vazamentos.
  • Temas avançados: Criptografia, Pentest, Resposta a Incidentes, Continuidade de Negócios.
  • Segurança em Nuvem: AWS, Azure ou Google Cloud Platform , incluindo boas práticas de segurança e conformidade.
  • Tecnologia de redes: firewalls, VLANs, VPNs, proxies, segmentação de rede.
  • Segurança em desenvolvimento de software: OWASP Top 10, DevSecOps, pipelines CI/CD, API security.

Soft Skills:
  • Comunicação clara e empática (com diferentes públicos, inclusive alta direção).
  • Pensamento crítico e visão estratégica.
  • Resolução de problemas complexos e tomada de decisão técnica.
  • Trabalho em equipe multidisciplinar.
  • Flexibilidade e adaptabilidade diante de novas demandas.

Diferenciais:
  • Certificações como CISM, CISSP, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer, CompTIA Security+.
  • Experiência com auditorias e certificações ISO 27001.
  • Participação em comitês de segurança, grupos de resposta a incidentes.
  • Atuação em projetos envolvendo APIs seguras, DevSecOps e ambientes regulados.

title: Senior Devops Engineer
description:
Join to apply for the Senior Devops Engineer role at Rain .

Rain is the fastest-growing earned wage access (EWA) fintech in the U.S., serving 2.5 million employees and backed by top investors like QED and Prosus.

We've raised nearly $400M in funding—including the largest Series A in fintech history—and just closed our Series B to fuel our next stage of hypergrowth. We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated DevOps Engineer to join our innovative and fast-paced team.

This role offers the opportunity to design, deploy, and manage scalable, cloud-native infrastructure to support modern applications. As a DevOps Engineer, you will work with cutting-edge tools and technologies, ensuring seamless integration and deployment for our microservices architecture. If you thrive in environments focused on automation, scalability, and observability, this is the perfect role for you!

Key Responsibilities:

  1. Infrastructure Automation: Design and implement infrastructure as code (IaC) using Terraform and Terragrunt. Automate provisioning and deployment of AWS resources to ensure high availability and scalability.
  2. Microservices Deployment: Build and manage containerized applications using Kubernetes with Helm for package management. Support and enhance microservices developed in Go (Golang).
  3. CI/CD Pipelines: Develop and maintain robust pipelines in GitLab CI/CD to enable seamless build, test, and deployment workflows. Optimize pipelines for performance, reliability, and security.
  4. Monitoring and Observability: Set up and maintain observability stacks using tools like Grafana, Prometheus, and Datadog. Monitor system health and performance, proactively identifying and resolving bottlenecks.
  5. Collaboration and Support: Collaborate with development and QA teams to ensure efficient application lifecycle management. Document processes, workflows, and playbooks for effective knowledge sharing.

Required Skills and Experience:

  • Proven experience with Kubernetes in production environments, including deploying and scaling applications.
  • Strong expertise in Terraform and Terragrunt for IaC.
  • Hands-on experience with GitLab CI/CD for building and managing pipelines.
  • Deep understanding of cloud infrastructure, preferably AWS.
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools like Grafana, Prometheus, and Datadog.
  • Familiarity with configuration management tools (e.g., Helm) and secure application deployment practices.
  • Public Cloud provider certifications in AWS & or Kubernetes is a plus.

Nice-to-Have Skills:

  • Experience with SRE practices and incident management workflows.
  • Proficiency in developing and deploying microservices, especially with Go (Golang).
  • Familiarity with multi-environment infrastructure setups and best practices.
  • Knowledge of database systems like PostgreSQL.
  • Experience with load balancing and auto-scaling in cloud-native environments.

Você será responsável por conduzir pesquisas com usuários, validar hipóteses de produto e liderar sessões de design sprint, colaborando com equipes multidisciplinares para resolver desafios complexos de forma ágil. Sua missão inclui a integração de soluções de inteligência artificial nos processos de design, análise de mercado para identificar tendências e oportunidades, além de desenvolver interfaces intuitivas utilizando Vue.js e Figma. Se você é apaixonado por inovação e busca impactar positivamente a experiência do usuário, queremos conhecê-lo!

Responsabilidades do cargo

  1. Atuar como Designer de Produto, criando, evoluindo e mantendo um Design System escalável e consistente, assegurando coesão visual e facilidade de implementação.
  2. Planejar e conduzir entrevistas, testes de usabilidade e pesquisas com usuários para identificar insights e oportunidades de melhoria, validando hipóteses de produto antes e após o desenvolvimento.

  5. Mapear o mercado e analisar concorrentes para identificar tendências de design e oportunidades de diferenciação.
  6. Compreender os objetivos de negócio e contribuir com ideias e soluções que agreguem valor para a empresa e os usuários.
  7. Criar wireframes, protótipos e mockups de alta fidelidade, desenvolvendo interfaces intuitivas e funcionais alinhadas ao Design System.
  8. Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares, incluindo desenvolvedores, product managers e stakeholders.
  9. Fomentar a inovação por meio da experimentação com novas tecnologias e práticas de design, propondo melhorias contínuas.
  10. Desenvolver e manter aplicações front-end em Vue.js, garantindo escalabilidade e desempenho.
  11. Domínio avançado de Figma, incluindo criação de componentes, protótipos navegáveis e uso de plugins de IA para geração de código.
  12. Implementar interfaces responsivas e acessíveis, traduzindo conceitos de IA em experiências intuitivas.
  13. Utilizar ferramentas de analytics como Google Analytics, Mixpanel e Hotjar.
  14. Colaborar com times de Produto, Design e Back-end para alinhar requisitos técnicos e funcionais.
  15. Garantir alta performance e otimização das aplicações, reduzindo tempos de carregamento.
  16. Criar e evoluir componentes reutilizáveis dentro do Design System.
  17. Implementar integrações com APIs de IA e serviços back-end, garantindo eficiência na comunicação de dados.
  18. Realizar testes automatizados e revisões de código.
  19. Pesquisar e aplicar boas práticas e tendências em front-end e IA.
  20. Identificar e corrigir bugs e problemas de usabilidade, assegurando um fluxo de navegação fluido.

Requisitos

  • Mínimo de 5 anos em design de produtos digitais, com portfólio que demonstre experiência em UI/UX.
  • Experiência significativa no desenvolvimento Front End com Vue.js e seu ecossistema (Vue Router, Vuex/Pinia, Composition API).
  • Vivência na condução de pesquisas com usuários, processos de discovery, validação e testes de usabilidade.
  • Experiência na criação e manutenção de Design Systems escaláveis.
  • Domínio avançado do Figma, incluindo Design System, criação de componentes, protótipos navegáveis e uso de plugins de IA para geração de código.
  • Profundo conhecimento em HTML, CSS e JavaScript.
  • Familiaridade com aplicações de inteligência artificial para prototipação rápida, pesquisa de usuário, análise de dados e geração de layouts e códigos.

Qualificações necessárias

title: Tech UI Designer - EGB
description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ART

What We Do

Push your artistic talent to the limit on a team of world-class environment, character and concept artists who strive to innovate and inspire.

What You'll Do

Epic Games is seeking talented, experienced Technical UI Designers to work on Fortnite. In this position, you will have a role as a collaborative team member implementing UI systems in Unreal engine, building rapid prototypes, layouts, visual scripting, and leveling up our workflows. You will work with UX Designers, UI Artists, and UI Engineers to ship these features to millions of users worldwide. The ideal candidate would have expertise in introductory algebra and geometry math ("Game math"), game systems, and fundamental programming principles.

In this role, you will

  • Work on UI Systems Design, break down feature/wireframes into necessary widgets, structures, and classes; increase UI performance by ensuring best practices are followed by colleagues
  • Ensure assets/UI are within memory and CPU constraints. Learning to profile performance and the costs of UMG/Slate/C++/and texture memory
  • Implement blueprint logic when presentation logic calls for it. Assist UI Artists where necessary in implementing special presentation behavior. Consult with UI engineers on the logic that will be in the blueprint vs native code
  • Debug blueprints/UMG issues quickly using various tools and techniques
  • Find ways to assist UX, UI Art, and UI engineering in organization, documentation, and building workflow improvements

What we're looking for

  • 3-6+ years of experience in building UI and experiences in game engines and across multiple platforms (mobile, web, pc, consoles) or similar transferable experience
  • 2+ years of experience shipping updates and new features to a user base on a regular cadence or similar transferable experience
  • Professional experience using game engines (Custom engine, Unity, UE4, Lumberyard, Snowdrop, etc.), and preparing game assets for them. You have an eye for pixel-perfect UI, translating and spotting various potential issues with mockups as you help see the designs into the engine
  • You are a logical problem solver and have attention to detail
  • You can "translate" communication across departments (talk to engineering about UI Art needs, summarize technical issues, etc.), but also have empathy for non-technical team members and the ability to empower others on your team

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

We pay 100% for benefits for both employees (EEs) and dependents (deps). Our current benefits package includes coverage for medical, dental, and life insurance. We also offer supplemental benefits including daily meal vouchers, and commuter benefits for onsite employees.

ABOUT US

Epic Games spans across 25 countries with 46 studios and 4,500+ employees globally. For over 25 years, we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

Like what you hear? Come be a part of something Epic!

title: Senior Portfolio Analyst
description:
Company Description

With over 6,000 employees in more than 20 countries, Statkraft is one of the leaders in hydropower internationally and the largest generator of renewable energy in Europe. The Norwegian group produces hydropower, wind power, solar power, gas-fired power, and provides district heating.

With actions guided by ethics and transparency, the company is headquartered in the city of Florianópolis, Santa Catarina (SC). Currently, it controls 26 renewable generation assets in Brazil. In November 2023, Statkraft signed the purchase of Enerfín, the renewable subsidiary of the Spanish company Elecnor, which includes nine operational wind farms in the states of Rio Grande do Sul and Rio Grande do Norte. Thus, the company became one of the largest wind power generators in Brazil, surpassing the mark of 2.2 GW of installed capacity, including acquisitions, constructions, and operations in the country.

The company is a pioneer in offering traceable renewable energy with a guarantee of origin in Brazil, certifying, through the I-REC (International Renewable Energy Certificate), the origin of its energy production, ensuring that the operation is sustainable.

Job Description

We are looking for someone who can lead the development and the implementation of portfolio tools for the Asset book, and support and propose commercial strategies for the asset portfolio, taking into consideration the expansion of the asset fleet (greenfield and M&A projects) also as R2M opportunities.

As part of this role, you will also:

  • Develop, improve and maintain the modelling of portfolio tools for the Asset book;
  • Propose and assess commercial strategies for the asset portfolio, focusing on long-term value creation and risk mitigation aspects;
  • Support Energy Management team on suggesting commercial strategies for maturities up to Y+5;
  • Assess the impact of Greenfield and M&A projects on the asset portfolio, including base case and sensitivities scenarios;
  • Support BD and M&A teams on the related processes;
  • Estimate the impact of R2M opportunities (LT PPAs, self-productions, etc) on the asset portfolio, taking into consideration updated market inputs from commercial teams (Trading and Origination);
  • Liaise closely with the risk department on P&L estimations and risk measurement for the Assets portfolio.

Qualifications

  • Degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, Economy or Business Administration;
  • Post Graduation in engineering or economics;
  • Solid experience in the electricity sector in Brazil;
  • Experience in portfolio management;
  • Knowledge in Risk Analysis and R / Python coding;
  • Fluent English and Portuguese.

Aqui, estudamos os movimentos da indústria para refletir nossa estratégia e criamos soluções tecnológicas, sempre idealizando e desenvolvendo técnicas e processos de automação.

Na Arquitetura e Apoio a Novos Negócios, você fará parte de um time apaixonado por inovação e transformação. Juntos, identificaremos novas oportunidades de mercado, construiremos novos modelos de negócio, apoiaremos transformações e garantiremos a execução de projetos estratégicos e processos críticos. Buscamos pessoas com pensamento crítico, forte capacidade analítica, de comunicação e apresentação, que estejam continuamente buscando conhecimento e sejam familiarizadas com o universo de tecnologia.

Criamos ambientes onde todas as pessoas são incluídas, acolhidas e valorizadas. Nos empenhamos em ser uma Globo cada vez mais diversa, em representatividade e pensamento, aprendendo uns com os outros e estimulando a criatividade e inovação.

Como será seu dia a dia:

  1. Ser protagonista na construção de modelagem de novos negócios ou transformação de negócios existentes;
  2. Orquestrar grupos de trabalho para promover a prontidão operacional de novos negócios através do desenho de processos de ponta a ponta;
  3. Criar, junto às áreas especialistas, planos de Disaster Recovery habilitando a continuidade do negócio;

Join to apply for the Senior DevOps Engineer role at Rain .

Rain is the fastest-growing earned wage access (EWA) fintech in the U.S., serving 2.5 million employees and backed by top investors like QED and Prosus.

We have raised nearly $400M in funding—including the largest Series A in fintech history—and recently closed our Series B to support our next stage of hypergrowth. We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated DevOps Engineer to join our innovative and fast-paced team.

This role offers the opportunity to design, deploy, and manage scalable, cloud-native infrastructure to support modern applications. You will work with cutting-edge tools and technologies, ensuring seamless integration and deployment for our microservices architecture. If you thrive in environments focused on automation, scalability, and observability, this is the perfect role for you!

Key Responsibilities:

  1. Infrastructure Automation: Design and implement infrastructure as code (IaC) using Terraform and Terragrunt. Automate provisioning and deployment of AWS resources to ensure high availability and scalability.
  2. Microservices Deployment: Build and manage containerized applications using Kubernetes with Helm for package management. Support and enhance microservices developed in Go (Golang).
  3. CI/CD Pipelines: Develop and maintain robust pipelines in GitLab CI/CD to enable seamless build, test, and deployment workflows. Optimize pipelines for performance, reliability, and security.
  4. Monitoring and Observability: Set up and maintain observability stacks using tools like Grafana, Prometheus, and Datadog. Monitor system health and performance, proactively identifying and resolving bottlenecks.
  5. Collaboration and Support: Collaborate with development and QA teams to ensure efficient application lifecycle management. Document processes, workflows, and playbooks for effective knowledge sharing.

Required Skills and Experience:

  1. Proven experience with Kubernetes in production environments, including deploying and scaling applications.
  2. Strong expertise in Terraform and Terragrunt for IaC.
  3. Hands-on experience with GitLab CI/CD for building and managing pipelines.
  4. Deep understanding of cloud infrastructure, preferably AWS.
  5. Experience with monitoring and observability tools like Grafana, Prometheus, and Datadog.
  6. Familiarity with configuration management tools (e.g., Helm) and secure application deployment practices.
  7. Public Cloud provider certifications in AWS & or Kubernetes is a plus.

Nice-to-Have Skills:

  1. Experience with SRE practices and incident management workflows.
  2. Proficiency in developing and deploying microservices, especially with Go (Golang).
  3. Familiarity with multi-environment infrastructure setups and best practices.
  4. Knowledge of database systems like PostgreSQL.
  5. Experience with load balancing and auto-scaling in cloud-native environments.

Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build asustainableeconomy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactionssecure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title and Summary

Senior Auditor The Internal Audit Department provides independent and objective assurance and advisory services to assess and enhance the effectiveness and efficiency of Mastercard’s governance, risk management and internal control processes. This position will be responsible for planning and executing global IT and operational audits and supporting the department’s integrated risk assessment and plan development.
Role:
• Understand the business and technology environment; effectively partner with stakeholders to understand associated risk and control environment
• Contribute to the annual risk assessment process and the development of the annual audit plan
• Deliver on time, high quality testing/audits, reviews, and advisory projects, with participation in all phases: planning/scoping, fieldwork, and reporting
• Evaluate compliance against legal, regulatory, policy and procedural requirements, and industry frameworks and best practices
• Assess design and operating effectiveness of controls through inquiry, observation, and inspection testing
• Identify, draft, and validate issues with business partners, accounting for impact, root cause, and risk severity
• Work with issue owners to drive the development of sustainable actions to remediate issues; regularly monitor issue progress and validate closure
• Provide credible challenge to stakeholders in all areas of audit coverage

All About You:
• Technology or Technology Risk Management professional (first/second line of defense, internal / external audit) or equivalent experience or exposure to both infrastructure and applications
• Knowledge of IT general computer controls, Information Security controls, and related processes and frameworks (i.e. NIST, COBIT, COSO, ISO)
• Knowledge of third party assurance reporting and frameworks (SOC, ISAE3000) is a plus
• Exposure to multiple computing environments (i.e. AWS, Mainframe, UNIX/Linux)
• Exposure and/or experience related to payments-related products and services, Open Banking, Data Management, and Artificial Intelligence is a plus
• Professional credentials (e.g., CIA, CISA, CISSP, or equivalent) are a plus
• Self-starter with ability to work independently and in a team setting
• Ability to handle multiple tasks and consistently meet established deadlines
• Travel opportunities based on need, 10% maximum

Corporate Security Responsibility


All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

  • Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;

  • Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;

  • Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and

  • Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

Vaga

A Enter está contratando para a posição de Front-End Engineer para desenvolver e otimizar interfaces web, garantindo bom desempenho e colaborando com as equipes de design e backend. O papel envolve transformar designs em componentes responsivos, resolver problemas de desempenho, integrar APIs e realizar revisões de código. A pessoa ideal é detalhista, experiente em tecnologias de front-end e se adapta bem a um ambiente dinâmico.

Responsabilidades

  • Colaborar com o restante do time de Engenharia, Produto e Design para desenvolver novos produtos e features para os usuários.

  • Garantir que nosso produto entrega uma experiência sem bugs e totalmente fluida.
  • Desenvolver componentes de UI reutilizáveis e responsivos.
  • Otimização constante da performance e experiência do usuário através de técnicas como CDN cache, virtualização de tabelas, lazy loading, memorização eficiente e estratégias inteligentes de data fetching, sempre em colaboração próxima com os outros Software Engineers para garantir contratos de API otimizados.
  • Desenvolver workflows robustos para processamento de documentos em tempo real, implementando feedbacks instantâneos para o usuário.
  • Evolução contínua da nossa biblioteca de componentes internos baseada em ShadCN, Tailwind e AG-Grid, priorizando acessibilidade, performance e consistência visual em toda a plataforma.
  • Manutenção e evolução do nosso monorepo unificado, utilizando tecnologias como Turborepo, Next.js, TypeScript, React.js, ShadCN, Tailwind e React Query. Nosso foco é manter uma base de código consistente e reutilizável para todas as aplicações web.

O que valorizamos

  • Profissionais que não se contentam com respostas superficiais e mergulham nos detalhes.
  • Baixa necessidade de reconhecimento individual, priorizando o resultado acima do crédito pessoal.

  • Disposição para aprender, orientar, liderar e seguir conforme necessário.
  • Senso de urgência desproporcional, mantendo em mente a escalabilidade e a criação de processos replicáveis para garantir o sucesso a longo prazo.
  • Pessoas curiosas e que conseguem aprender coisas difíceis rapidamente.

Idealmente, você tem:

  • De 2 a 4 anos de experiência profissional com Front-End.
  • Experiência com React, JavaScript, HTML e CSS.

description:
Product Owner Junior | Infraestrutura - Vaga exclusiva para mulheres

Job Description

Nossa área de Estratégia e Tecnologia é um pilar fundamental dos nossos negócios, sendo responsável pela nossa transformação digital. Aqui criamos soluções tecnológicas sempre idealizando e desenvolvendo técnicas e processos de automação, seja para aprimorar a experiência de trabalho das nossas equipes ou aumentar a capacidade de entrega dos nossos produtos e serviços.

Nós somos responsáveis por uma infraestrutura gigantesca que atende aos principais produtos de vídeo da Globo, como o Globoplay, Premiere e os Canais Globo. Além disso, somos responsáveis pela transmissão ao vivo de grandes eventos - desde os campeonatos estaduais de futebol, a Copa do Mundo, Olimpíadas, Rock in Rio e até as câmeras ao vivo do Big Brother Brasil, que fica disponível 24x7 para todos os assinantes do Globoplay.

Criamos ambientes onde todas as pessoas são incluídas, acolhidas e valorizadas. Nos empenhamos em ser uma Globo cada vez mais diversa, em representatividade e pensamento, aprendendo uns com os outros e estimulando a criatividade e inovação.

Acreditamos na intencionalidade para gerar movimentos transformadores, que reconheçam que diferentes grupos sociais partem de diferentes realidades que precisam ser levadas em consideração e acolhidas pelas pessoas e pelo negócio.

Equipes representativas trazem inovação inclusiva, nos permitindo criar experiências emocionantes para diferentes tipos de pessoas.

Queremos ser cada vez mais o lugar onde todas as pessoas se encontram e, por isso, essa vaga é para você, mulher , que quer crescer e construir o futuro com a gente, nos bastidores de produtos e serviços que impactam a vida de milhões de brasileiros e brasileiras todos os dias.

Responsibilities and assignments

  • Gerenciar iniciativas com foco em Produtos e Projetos de Infraestrutura Digital, ora com visão ágil, ora com visão waterfall, sempre se adequando à entrega;
  • Criar forte relacionamento com áreas internas parceiras (suprimentos, jurídico, financeiro e fiscal) além de fornecedores externos (Dell, HP, AD Digital, Google, AWS, Microsoft, entre outros);
  • Conceituar, especificar e detalhar os objetivos das iniciativas, envolvendo todas as partes interessadas, com forte comunicação e alinhamento de expectativas, coordenando e engajando recursos internos e externos, garantindo que todas as iniciativas sejam entregues atingindo os objetivos do produto, dentro do prazo e orçamento;
  • Engajar o grupo de trabalho para especificar as tecnologias a serem implantadas em conjunto, definindo os papéis e responsabilidades de cada um durante o esforço colaborativo e durante a fase de operação;
  • Realizar provas de conceito e comissionamento de equipamentos e ou soluções em conjunto com o time especialista e fornecedores;
  • Coletar, analisar e modelar dados para apoio nas tomadas de decisão das iniciativas do Produto/Projeto;
  • Apoiar as squads de desenvolvimento com direcionamento generalista sobre o produto que está sendo desenvolvido, com conhecimento de negócio e do workflow de mídias e publicidade e processuais das demais áreas;
  • Gerenciar o backlog OT/IT/dev da plataforma de entrega de conteúdo digital das áreas de produção de conteúdo e distribuição da Globo para as plataformas digitais como Globoplay, G1, GE, GSHOW e parceiros licenciados como NOW, Looke, TAP, HANDS e etc;
  • Gerir orçamentos, bem como cuidar da execução de contratação junto ao time de suprimentos e seu pagamento com o time de Contas a Pagar;
  • Gerir cronogramas/roadmap, identificando e mapeando antecipadamente riscos que impeçam ou comprometam as entregas acordadas com as partes interessadas;
  • Influenciar e negociar priorizações com os mais diversos times de tecnologia e negócio com foco nas entregas acordadas no projeto/produto;
  • Realizar periodicamente reuniões de status com os principais stakeholders do projeto/produto, levando informações relevantes para tomadas de decisão.

Requirements And Qualifications

Do que você precisa:

  • Ensino superior em Engenharia ou áreas relacionadas em TI (concluído ou próximo da conclusão);
  • Conhecimentos básicos sobre as tecnologias: Servidores e Sistemas Operacionais, Bancos de Dados, Servidores de Aplicação, Redes, Segurança da Informação, Monitoração, Storage e Backup, Virtualização, Contêineres e Cloud Computing;
  • Experiência de pelo menos 1 ano em Gestão de Produtos ou Projetos de Tecnologia, principalmente em infraestrutura de TI;
  • Conhecimento intermediário nas ferramentas Microsoft Office, principalmente o Project e Power Point;
  • Inglês básico;
  • Power BI básico.

Conhecimentos que te destacam:

  • Especializações em Métodos Ágeis para gestão de projetos/produtos;
  • Pós-Graduação ou MBA em Gestão ou áreas técnicas de Engenharia/TI;
  • Certificações em gestão de projetos como: PMP, PMI-ACP, CSPO, CSM, KMP e outras;
  • Habilidade de comunicação e gestão de equipes multidisciplinares.

Por que vir para Globo:

Vem e vamos criar histórias e tecnologias juntos. Na Globo, o encontro de histórias com tecnologia move um time diverso e apaixonado por inovação. A gente tem a chance de aproximar os brasileiros, criando novas formas de se conectar com eles. Aqui, cada um faz a transformação acontecer.

Nossos processos seletivos estão acontecendo de forma 100% remota e nós encorajamos inscrições de qualquer lugar do Brasil e do mundo. #vempraglobo

Seguindo o compromisso de contribuir para um ambiente seguro para nossas pessoas, informamos que ter o esquema completo vacinação contra a Covid-19 é uma condição obrigatória para o trabalho na Globo, presencial ou a distância, e que o comprovante deverá ser apresentado como pré-requisito para a contratação.

The Senior Director will serve as Project Manager to internal investigations, forensic accounting, compliance, data analytics, and damages matters. This professional will manage other consultants in order to attend project needs and will oversee all work product and client deliverables under her umbrella to maintain quality.

The candidate will assist our clients in various industries by applying the principles of economics, statistics, accounting, and finance to address complex issues that arise in dispute resolution in areas such as antitrust and competition, intellectual property, and commercial damages. Naturally the person would need to leverage quantitative data and qualitative research to answer questions specific to each project.

This is an ideal opportunity for someone who:

  • Learns well on the fly - while we do have training materials and sessions, most of the learning occurs on the job from your colleagues as you contribute to a project.
  • Is technically minded - all our work requires thinking in a logical, mathematical way about processes and sets of data.
  • Works flexibly with a variety of team members - we work on a variety of projects at the same time, each of which can be staffed differently.
  • Is eager and excited to lead a team - a positive, open-minded attitude will ensure quality work and bodes well for long-term career development.
  • Works hard - while we do innovate, everyone has regular assigned tasks that are part of the overall workflow and on which high quality client service depends.
  • Enjoys solving the impossible - we often receive requests that require us to consider difficult questions and develop new processes.

What You'll Do

  • Oversee daily project activities, collaborating with consultants, supervisors, subcontractors, and clients, and serving as the project lead on disputes, arbitration, and consultancy tasks.
  • Ensure quality and consistency by reviewing deliverables from team members and subcontractors, maintaining organized and high-standard outputs.
  • Perform financial and economic analyses, including damages estimation, financial modeling, and supporting dispute strategies for clients.
  • Lead regional business development efforts to grow disputes and arbitration services, developing innovative and tailored client solutions.
  • Prepare reports, presentations, and business cases; leverage data analytics and e-Discovery tools; and create dashboards using platforms like Excel, Power BI, and Tableau.
  • Support litigation processes by adducing evidence in courts and tribunals, conducting industry research, and building strong client relationships through timely and professional service.
  • Manage overall client engagement strategies, including leveraging data insights to identify opportunities for growth and managing channel execution across platforms such as Salesforce and the company's website.

What You Will Need To Succeed

Basic Qualifications

  • BS or BA college degree required (Bachelor of Accounting, Business, Economics or Finance).
  • Master´s degree (Masters of Finance, MBA etc.).
  • Minimum 7+ years of post-graduate consulting experience in litigation support, arbitration, and/or investigations.
  • Fluency in both written and spoken English and Portuguese.
  • Ability to travel 20%.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Proven track record of adducing evidence in courts and/or tribunals and experience working with both local and international disputes.
  • Good knowledge of database management and database software with proven quality and review skills.
  • Strong proficiency with Windows and related software, especially Microsoft Excel.
  • Excellent communication and client interface skills (verbal and written).
  • Ability to work independently in fast-paced, multi-task environment.
  • Proven ability to conduct training in a professional environment.
  • Experience assigning work to subcontractors, negotiating budgets, and deadlines.

Especialista em Desenvolvimento de Produtos PJ

VENHA FAZER PARTE DO TIME DE ESPECIALISTAS DO BANCO SAFRA!

Com 180 anos de história, seguimos em expansão. Buscamos pessoas que sustentem o nosso legado nos negócios com visão orientada para uma constante evolução tecnológica. Aqui você vai encontrar mais do que excelentes benefícios em uma referência no mercado financeiro. Você fará parte de uma instituição que valoriza a cultura ESG, preza por um ambiente harmonioso, com pessoas acessíveis, e promove diversas iniciativas para o desenvolvimento de carreiras.

Sobre a área de Desenvolvimento de Produtos PJ

Responsável pelo desenvolvimento de novos produtos, aprimoramento dos existentes durante seu ciclo de vida, atuação em incidentes para garantir qualidade e experiência do cliente, sempre focando na minimização de riscos e conformidade regulatória.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  1. Controlar e garantir o funcionamento dos Produtos Ativos PJ existentes, além de criar, discutir e propor novos produtos e funcionalidades conforme demanda de mercado e regulatória;

  4. Gerenciar o backlog de melhorias, priorizando de acordo com as necessidades do negócio;
  5. Reportar periodicamente o progresso dos projetos à liderança.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Conhecimento em Produtos de financiamento e empréstimos;
  • Experiência com ciclo de vida de produtos em atuação;
  • Familiaridade com temas regulatórios internos (Compliance e Auditoria) e externos (BACEN);
  • SQL (Nível Básico/Intermediário);
  • Power BI (Nível Básico/Intermediário);
  • Perfil analítico com conhecimento em ferramentas de análise e estruturação de dados.

Informações adicionais

  • Plano de desenvolvimento de carreira sob medida, com amplo networking e oportunidades de crescimento;
  • Trilha de capacitação para habilidades técnicas e comportamentais;

Descrição do emprego

We are looking for a highly motivated Senior Product Engineer to lead the integration of transmission systems for hybrid and internal combustion vehicle platforms. This role requires a deep understanding of embedded control systems, diagnostics, and cross-functional collaboration in a global environment.

The selected candidate will interface with systems and calibration engineers to align on functional requirements, assess impacts on regulatory and safety standards, and lead the implementation of software and diagnostic strategies. You will be responsible for ensuring software quality, calibration traceability, and validation of system performance throughout the product lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

  • Interface with systems and calibration teams to interpret and refine control requirements.
  • Lead assessments and documentation related to regulatory compliance and functional safety.
  • Develop diagnostic strategies and clearly communicate with global stakeholders via reports and presentations.
  • Review and mark up control models to meet diagnostic and systems design criteria.
  • Manage software and calibration integration for automatic transmissions.
  • Track and document software versions, issues, and change requests.
  • Perform fault analysis, data acquisition, and control system validation (PID, cruise, performance).
  • Support software releases, troubleshooting, and vehicle-level testing during development and production phases.

Qualificações

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Mechatronics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • Fluent in English (written and verbal).
  • Experience with automotive ECUs, control systems, hydraulic/electrical subsystems, and combustion physics.
  • Solid knowledge of internal combustion engines and hybrid powertrain systems.
  • Familiarity with propulsion components (engine, driveline, electric/hydraulic subsystems).

Technical Skills

  • V-cycle software development process understanding.
  • Experience with problem-solving techniques (DFMEA, DFSS, DVPR).
  • Basic knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies.
  • Knowledge of tools for project tracking and development workflows.
  • Understanding of development architectures such as aSPICE, PLE, AUTOSAR, and ISO 26262.
  • Advanced proficiency with MATLAB/Simulink and control model development.
  • Experience with ETAS INCA, CANalyzer, and Candela (Vector tools).
  • Programming skills in C or C++; Python is a plus.
  • Familiarity with CAN protocol (SAE J1939).
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite and Google Workspace.

Soft Skills

  • Strong analytical and diagnostic skills.
  • Multidisciplinary mindset with a proactive, hands-on approach.
  • Clear and confident communicator across technical and non-technical teams.
  • Fast learner with a passion for continuous improvement and innovation.

description:
Talent Account Director 4 - LinkedIn Talent Solutions (LATAM)

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Company Description
LinkedIn is the world’s largest professional network, built to create economic opportunity for every member of the global workforce. Our products help people make powerful connections, discover exciting opportunities, build necessary skills, and gain valuable insights every day. We’re also committed to providing transformational opportunities for our own employees by investing in their growth. We aspire to create a culture that’s built on trust, care, inclusion, and fun – where everyone can succeed.

Join us to transform the way the world works.

Job Description

This role will be based in São Paulo, Brazil.

At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team.

We’re looking for a high-performing, results-driven Account Director to join our Large Enterprise team, with a strong commercial mindset and a passion for solving talent challenges through LinkedIn’s Talent & Learning solutions. This role is ideal for someone who combines strategic thinking with execution excellence, thrives in complex deal environments, and is relentless in pursuing growth.

You will serve as a trusted business partner, building deep relationships while driving revenue, expanding accounts, and delivering measurable value to clients. If you’re motivated by goals, energized by challenges, and committed to long-term client success, this role is for you.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Identify, create, and close new business opportunities within a defined set of strategic enterprise accounts.
  • Understand the client’s business strategy and talent priorities to build tailored, outcome-driven proposals.
  • Lead high-impact conversations across multiple stakeholders — from HR to C-level — adapting messaging and approach to each audience.
  • Sell solutions, not products, aligning LinkedIn’s value proposition with the customer’s specific goals and pain points.
  • Navigate complex negotiations with confidence, applying commercial acumen to craft win-win agreements.
  • Use data and insights to overcome objections and support strategic investment decisions.
  • Proactively manage account health and mitigate churn through a consultative, ROI-focused approach.
  • Map stakeholders, assess relationship depth, and execute targeted engagement strategies.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Customer Success, Product Specialists, and Sales Support to ensure consistent customer impact and revenue growth.
  • Inspire across lines of business and regions by exemplifying LinkedIn cultures and values and set the bar for excellence for the rest of the team.
  • Strategically leverage internal leaders, who meet directly with clients, to accelerate business success.
  • Deliver predictable and accurate forecasts, while exceeding quarterly and annual sales targets.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of applicable full-cycle, closing sales experience
  • Native/Fluent in Portuguese
  • Business fluency in English

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Proven success in selling SaaS or technology solutions to large enterprise clients in Brazil
  • Experience with HR tech or talent-related platforms
  • Strong understanding of software licensing, pricing models, and commercial negotiations
  • Strong communication, negotiation, and account planning skills
  • Ability to educate, influence, and build consensus among multiple decision makers
  • Track record of developing strategic account plans that lead to long-term growth
  • Experience using insights and data to drive commercial decisions
  • Demonstrated ability to lead with value in a competitive sales environment

Suggested Skills:

  • Negotiation
  • Forecasting
  • Communication
  • Strategic Planning

title: Jurubatuba | Analista de Projetos de Segurança do Trabalho PL
description:
Jurubatuba | Analista de Projetos de Segurança do Trabalho PL

Join to apply for the Jurubatuba | Analista de Projetos de Segurança do Trabalho PL role at Coca-Cola FEMSA .

Somos a Coca-Cola FEMSA (KOF), uma das maiores engarrafadoras e comerciantes do mundo em volume do sistema Coca-Cola. Diariamente atendemos mais de 381 milhões de pessoas na América Latina. Operando 56 unidades de manufatura e 249 centros de distribuição, nossos mais de 97 mil funcionários nos permitem representar mais de 169 marcas líderes nos diferentes territórios em que estamos presentes. Na Coca-Cola FEMSA, todos os dias é uma oportunidade para aprender e crescer.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Resumo da posição/área: Responsável por atuar no desenvolvimento, implementação e gestão de projetos estratégicos voltados à padronização, inovação, aplicação de tecnologias e otimização de processos com foco em Segurança do Trabalho e Segurança Viária. Atua no ciclo completo de gestão de indicadores dessas áreas, desde a identificação de indicadores críticos, desenvolvimento de estruturas de medição, capacitação das áreas para alimentação dos dados, monitoramento de resultados e análise crítica de desempenho com uso de ferramentas de BI. Com base nas análises, propõe, desenvolve e implementa projetos e iniciativas de melhoria, engajando stakeholders e avaliando continuamente a eficácia das ações implementadas. Utiliza metodologias ágeis e tradicionais de gestão de projetos, garantindo excelência em prazo, custo, escopo e qualidade, e promovendo a evolução da cultura de segurança da organização.

Responsabilidades:

  • Conduzir o planejamento, a execução e o monitoramento de projetos estratégicos em Segurança do Trabalho e Segurança Viária, assegurando aderência às diretrizes corporativas, conformidade legal e alinhamento com as normas técnicas e regulatórias vigentes.
  • Desenvolver soluções técnicas, padrões operacionais e modelos de gestão aplicáveis às unidades operacionais, promovendo a padronização, a mitigação de riscos e a excelência na gestão preventiva.
  • Liderar o mapeamento e a reestruturação de processos críticos relacionados à segurança ocupacional e viária, com foco em eficiência operacional, controle de riscos e fortalecimento da governança.
  • Apoiar a integração de tecnologias emergentes e sistemas inteligentes, como sensores, automação de controles, análise preditiva de dados e plataformas de monitoramento digital, impulsionando a inovação aplicada à segurança.
  • Gerir o ciclo de indicadores de Segurança do Trabalho, Segurança Viária e Modelos de Segurança, desde a definição, desenvolvimento e monitoramento com uso de BI, até a análise crítica de resultados, desenvolvimento de projetos e iniciativas de melhoria e avaliação contínua da eficácia, engajando stakeholders em todas as etapas.
  • Consolidar resultados de indicadores de Segurança do Trabalho, Segurança Viária e Modelos de Segurança, elaborar análises críticas e apresentações executivas, e conduzir fechamentos periódicos de resultados, promovendo a comunicação clara do desempenho e das ações de melhoria.
  • Fortalecer a cultura de segurança da organização, atuando como agente de transformação, disseminando boas práticas, conduzindo capacitações técnicas e participando de fóruns técnicos internos e externos.
  • Elaborar relatórios técnicos, apresentações executivas e materiais de comunicação, garantindo clareza, consistência e aderência ao público estratégico em diferentes níveis da organização.
  • Contribuir ativamente para a gestão do portfólio de projetos da área, participando da priorização de iniciativas com base em critérios técnicos, de risco, impacto e viabilidade econômico-financeira.
  • Apoiar a gestão de custos, CAPEX e OPEX dos projetos, realizando estimativas orçamentárias, acompanhando a execução financeira e identificando oportunidades de otimização de recursos e escalabilidade.

Requisitos e qualificações

Requisitos:

  • Formação: Ensino Superior completo em Engenharia, ou áreas correlatas (desejável: Segurança do Trabalho e Gestão de Projetos).
  • Experiência: Atuação prévia em projetos relacionados à segurança do trabalho, segurança viária ou inovação em ambientes industriais/logísticos. Desejável vivência anterior na área de Segurança do Trabalho.
  • Conhecimento Técnico: Power BI, Excel avançado, MS Project, PowerPoint e plataformas colaborativas (Teams, SharePoint). Desejável conhecimento em normas e requisitos legais como NRs, ISSO 450001. Mapeamento e melhoria de processos como BPMN, SIPOC, PDCA, 5W2H e análise de causa raiz aplicados à segurança e eficiência operacional e metodologias de gestão de projetos como PMBOOK, Scrum, Kanban e ferramentas de controle de escopo.
  • Idiomas: Desejável conhecimento básico em espanhol.
  • CNH: Categoria B.
  • Sofisticação de habilidades comportamentais: Buscamos um profissional proativo, com senso de dono e atitude realizadora. É essencial ter pensamento crítico, curiosidade, boa comunicação, criatividade e dinamismo para propor soluções, inovar e agregar valor com entregas de qualidade.

Informações adicionais

O que iremos te oferecer:

  • PPR

  • Plano de saúde
  • Plano Odontológico por adesão conforme escolha do colaborador

title: Software Engineering Manager - SORA
description:
Sora, an ADP company, is hiring a Software Engineering Manager .

Are you inspired by transformation and making an impact on the lives of millions of people every day, even when it's messy?

Are you empathic to client needs, the people you lead, and internal partners to drive success but can make the hard calls and are not afraid to make bold moves?

Are you a technologist first and foremost who approaches every problem wearing that hat while going out of your way to champion creativity and build diverse, productive, and engaged teams?

Well, this may be the role for you. Ready to design what's next?

Sora , an HR Workflow automation product , is empowering people-focused teams to create exceptional employee experiences. These teams should be spending time with people, but unfortunately all facets of People teams are bogged down by managing processes instead of helping people. That’s where Sora comes in: we’re building a product that streamlines the tedious and repetitive work People teams do every day, from sending emails to assigning onboarding tasks to a new hire’s manager.

As a Software Engineering Manager , you will lead one or multiple teams of 5-10 software engineers and testers who are building not only the future of Sora but also the future of ADP’s HR product suite. No two days are alike. You will be a hands-on, working manager, responsible for your own deliverables (including technical design and coding tickets), as well as managing your direct reports. You will spend your time checking in with your team, facilitating the team's work through coaching and guidance, being a guiding voice for technical decisions, and providing leadership with realistic expectations and deadlines. You will be accountable for the quality of products that impact people's lives.

To thrive in this role, you need a solid understanding of software development at scale, including recent hands-on coding experience in our stack (NodeJS, React, AWS), a strong knowledge of functional programming, JavaScript, cloud services, relational databases, Redis, and microservice architectures. Your ability to communicate clearly and effectively will keep the team informed of company-wide initiatives and make leaders comfortable with the team's progress. Collaboration and exchange of ideas are central to our projects. You should be a role model for motivation and maintaining positive momentum and energy. Pace does not scare you. You help everyone understand the big picture and deliver.

Communication and transparency are key! You and your team will work closely with multiple product and development teams across the US, involving frequent communication, virtual meetings, and strong asynchronous collaboration. This role is ideal for someone proactive, easy to work with, and adaptable to a fast-paced environment. If you enjoy collaboration and staying organized, this could be a great fit!

Interested? Apply now!

Learn more about ADP at tech.adp.com/careers

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

Here's what you can expect on a typical day:

  • Drive cultural change and transformation. Lead, inspire, and engage a team as you continue to develop and deliver our next-generation platform to clients.
  • Build teams that thrive. Check in with your engineering team and US-based teams daily to identify priorities and challenges. Share knowledge, motivate, and keep everyone engaged and productive.
  • Build products. Use your technical expertise to review approaches, help your team excel in an Agile environment, and contribute hands-on as a manager and coach.
  • Variety of work. No typical day: from checking in with team members, meeting with leadership, to handling ad hoc requests. Approximate work breakdown: 25% coding, 50% technical design/architecture, 25% people management.
  • Influence and inspire confidence. Present to senior leaders, product owners, and peers with executive presence, leading change and creating clear communications on milestones.
  • Management Experience. 2+ years / 5-10+ years of engineering management experience, with a background in developing software systems at scale.
  • Development Experience. Recent (within last 2 years) hands-on development as a senior engineer (5-8+ years total), familiar with our stack (NodeJS, React, AWS), ready to contribute technically.

TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent.
  • 2+ years of recent management or team lead experience.
  • Recent professional experience in relevant skills (NodeJS, React, Postgres, AWS) within the last 2 years, with 5-8+ years of total development experience.
  • Experience in technical planning, leading projects, and collaborating across teams.
  • 3-5 years as a technical leader and mentor.
  • (Preferred) Experience with distributed systems, database architecture, observability, security, message queuing.
  • Experience managing multiple teams with competing priorities.

*The ADP work model is office-based with up to two days remote work per week.

*Due to the sensitive nature of the data involved, ADP reserves the right to conduct background checks periodically, with candidate consent, as authorized by relevant legal provisions.

Qual será a sua missão
Estamos em busca de uma pessoa para assumir a posição de Finance Lead cujo objetivo será garantir a solidez e a conformidade das operações financeiras, por meio da elaboração de relatórios precisos e pontuais, gestão eficiente dos processos contábeis e fiscais, e suporte estratégico às áreas internas. Job Description
Como será o seu dia a dia

  • Elaborar relatórios financeiros e gerenciais mensais de forma precisa e dentro dos prazos estabelecidos;
  • Auxiliar na garantia de procedimentos eficazes de controle interno e conformidade com normas contábeis, políticas da empresa e exigências legais;
  • Colaborar com a área financeira da matriz para assegurar que as práticas locais estejam de acordo com as políticas do grupo e regulamentações locais;
  • Gerenciar as questões fiscais e minimizar os encargos tributários da empresa;
  • Fornecer orientações e suporte contábil para diferentes equipes e partes interessadas internas;
  • Planejar e participar continuamente de projetos de melhoria de processos;
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com as equipes de vendas e atendimento ao cliente para garantir uma gestão de crédito eficiente e eficaz;
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre tendências do setor e melhores práticas em gestão de crédito;
  • Preparar relatórios e apresentar os resultados à alta liderança.
Requirements

  • Graduação completa em Ciências Contábeis;
  • Experiência sólida com temas relacionados à crédito;
  • Atuação em fintechs será um diferencial;
  • Experiência em liderança de equipes;
  • Inglês avançado (será testado durante o processo de seleção).

Com 16 anos de atuação, a Log se firmou como líder no mercado de desenvolvimento de ativos logísticos greenfield e locação de galpões de alto padrão no Brasil. title: Supervisor Comercial
description:
O Supervisor de Vendas será responsável por liderar e gerenciar a equipe de vendas. A função exige habilidades de liderança, análise e uma compreensão abrangente do processo de vendas.

Objetivos e Responsabilidades

Objetivo: Supervisionar e orientar a equipe de vendas, garantindo o cumprimento das metas de vendas e o alinhamento com os objetivos da empresa.

O Supervisor de Vendas terá as seguintes responsabilidades:

  • Liderar a Equipe de Vendas : Fornecer orientação, treinamento e suporte para os vendedores, assegurando que eles atinjam seus objetivos.
  • Definir e Monitorar Metas : Estabelecer metas de vendas, monitorar o desempenho e implementar planos de ação quando necessário.
  • Desenvolver Estratégias de Vendas : Criar e implementar estratégias eficazes para melhorar o desempenho de vendas.
  • Analisar Desempenho e Relatórios : Avaliar o desempenho da equipe, preparar relatórios e fornecer feedbacks construtivos.
  • Colaborar com Outros Departamentos : Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com marketing, suporte ao cliente e outras áreas para garantir uma abordagem integrada às vendas.

Requisitos Fundamentais

  • Ensino superior em Administração, Marketing ou área relacionada; Experiência anterior em vendas e liderança de equipe.
  • Habilidades de liderança e gerenciamento de pessoas.
  • Conhecimento profundo do processo de vendas e dos produtos ou serviços da empresa.
  • Capacidade de analisar dados e medir o desempenho.

Habilidades Desejadas

  • Excelente comunicação e habilidades interpessoais.
  • Capacidade de desenvolver e implementar estratégias de vendas.
  • Habilidade em motivação e desenvolvimento de equipe.

Referências Comportamentais

  • Liderança Inspiradora - Capacidade de inspirar, motivar e orientar a equipe.
  • Visão Estratégica - Habilidade em desenvolver e implementar estratégias de vendas eficazes.
  • Colaboração - Trabalhar em conjunto com outras equipes para otimizar o processo de vendas.

O(a) profissional será responsável por criar análises, relatórios e dashboards que facilitem a visualização da eficácia das campanhas e o impacto das estratégias de mídia.

Essa posição é ideal para quem possui experiência em mídia digital e deseja expandir suas competências para a área de Business Intelligence, assumindo uma postura mais analítica e estratégica em projetos desafiadores.

Buscamos um profissional analítico, curioso e orientado a resultados, com experiência em mídia digital e interesse em aprofundar suas habilidades em Business Intelligence.

title: Hard Surface Outsourcing Lead
description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ART What We Do

Push your artistic talent to the limit on a team of world-class environment, character and concept artists who strive to innovate and inspire.

What You'll Do

Epic Games is searching for an experienced Hard Surface Outsourcing Lead to support and supervise creative hard surface content provided by outsource partners. Working alongside Hard Surface Art Leads, and reporting to the Hard Surface Director, the Outsource Lead will provide front-line creative feedback for work submitted for Epic review. Though the role will be mainly supervisory, the individual should be an experienced artist, having worked in AAA titles before, and have a solid hands-on art background, with a very strong foundation of 3D modelling for both hard and soft surfaces. The ideal candidate would be a talented 3D artist who is able to communicate equally effectively, both with outsource partners and internal teams, to ensure the timely delivery of high quality assets to the next stage in the art pipeline. Their skills will include; a keen artistic eye for ‘clean’ 3D modelling, documenting existing pipelines, creating blockouts, paintovers and exemplar assets and, ultimately, providing clear visual feedback to vendors at each stage of the process.

In this role, you will
  • Work closely with the HS Director and HS Art Leads to pull together clear creative direction for the assets to be created, and then ensure this information is packaged and conveyed to the Vendor as clearly as possible. Work with Directors, Production, and internal partners to evaluate, hire, and onboard vendors
  • Collect or generate detailed documentation, video reference, and examples of art asset production, procedures, and engine requirements to support the external vendors
  • If required, making any needed fixes to keep assets consistent and technically game ready as they’re handed off from the outsource partner
  • Clearly communicating modeling and paint feedback to the outsource partner, and ensuring those creative notes and goals are met. Informing leadership in the event that isn’t happening
  • Communicating and partnering with the HS implementation team ensuring outsourced assets are ingested into the pipeline and engine correctly
  • When required, some amount of hands-on art production delivering assets for the project, ensuring they are familiar with and capable of working inside of the Epic pipeline
  • Bug support, triage, and resolution for any art assets that have been created by the outsourcing team
What we're looking for
  • Experience in shipping AAA titles across multiple platforms
  • Experienced shipping 3D production assets for games in either character, weapon, or prop disciplines
  • Experienced in game art asset creation in a variety of software packages including Maya, 3ds Max, Zbrush, Photoshop, Substance, etc
  • Experience in modeling, creating UV's and texturing is essential
  • Must be highly organized, self-driven, customer focused, and a great team player
  • Must be a clear and concise communicator, able to deliver complex creative feedback across external vendor locations
  • Experienced working within a team and a high pressure production environment
  • You’re user-focused, passionate, solutions-focused, and innovative
  • A PLUS - Fluency in a languages other than English, including Chinese, German, Spanish, Italian, or Russia
EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

We pay 100% for benefits for both employees (EEs) and dependents (deps). Our current benefits package includes coverage for medical, dental, and life insurance. We also offer supplemental benefits including daily meal vouchers, and commuter benefits for onsite employees.

ABOUT US

Epic Games spans across 25 countries with 46 studios and 4,500+ employees globally. For over 25 years, we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

Like what you hear? Come be a part of something Epic!

Epic Games deeply values diverse teams and an inclusive work culture, and we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. Learn more about our Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Policy here .

We will not pay any fees to any unauthorized third party. Further details on these matters can be found here .

O Corretor de Imóveis será responsável por identificar, prospectar e negociar terrenos urbanos na Paraíba, com área mínima de 1.000 m² e ligação trifásica, para implantação de projetos de energia solar. title: Analyst, Technical Success Manager
description:
At Qualtrics, we create software the world’s best brands use to deliver exceptional frontline experiences, build high-performing teams, and design products people love. But we are more than a platform—we are the creators and stewards of the Experience Management category serving over 18K clients globally. Building a category takes grit, determination, and a disdain for convention—but most of all it requires close-knit, high-functioning teams with an unwavering dedication to serving our customers. When you join one of our teams, you’ll be part of a nimble group that’s empowered to set aggressive goals and move fast to achieve them. Strategic risks are encouraged and complex problems are solved together, by passing the microphone and iterating until the best solution comes to light. You won’t have to look to find growth opportunities—ready or not, they’ll find you. From retail to government to healthcare, we’re on a mission to bring humanity, connection, and empathy back to business. Join over 5,000 people across the globe who think that’s work worth doing.

Analyst, Technical Success Manager

Why We Have This Role

The Customer Success Team is at the heart of Qualtrics. From the initial onboarding to ongoing adoption, we assist customers throughout their lifecycle, helping them unlock the most value from our products and services. We understand their goals and, as trusted advisors, will help them deliver on their business objectives and recommend solutions to the challenges they face. We are looking for resourceful individuals to join our team who aren’t afraid to dive into the details and understand the tools our customers use, and working with them to realize long term value. We have impressive members on this team, and are always looking for more amazing talent!

How You’ll Find Success

  • Technical Success Managers are Qualtrics experts who work with our clients and customers to realize the potential of the Qualtrics product.
  • In this role, you will work with clients to understand the customers programs and objectives, and leverage your technical expertise to build programs that drive adoption and value for the customer.
  • Technical Success Managers work in a post-sales capacity that directly contributes to the long-term success of our customers’ programs, and deepen relationships with the clients they support.
  • As a Technical Success Manager, you should both be a tech-savvy professional and someone who excels at nurturing relationships to deliver exceptional client service.

How You’ll Grow

  • Enhance your software platform knowledge and technical troubleshooting skills
  • Build your creative problem-solving and critical-thinking skills to deliver actionable, scalable recommendations that improve the end to end customer experience for customers
  • Develop critical customer relationship and communication skills to develop impactful, trusted relationships

Things You’ll Do


Drive Customer Adoption and Optimize Programs

    • Build, configure, and execute services that align to client objectives, strategic goals, maximizing client value
    • Leverage customer usage data to deliver actionable insights & recommendations
    • Develop a deep understanding of Qualtrics’ service offerings to meet client needs, guiding them through use cases to drive program maturity.
    • Establish and maintain multi-level stakeholder relationships to ensure customer health and support.
    • Serve as a platform expert, advising clients on high-value usage and translating customer goals into tailored recommendations.
    • Act as a point of escalation for complex issues, championing customer needs internally and mobilizing resources for maximum impact.
    • Drive adoption of key platform features through demos and proof of concepts, leveraging best practices for implementation.
    • In person connection with customers, traveling on-site as needed


Collaboration & Cross-Functional Partnerships

    • Collaborate with Sales and Services teams to develop meaningful client relationships, aligned to the overall client account strategy
    • Develop cross-functional initiatives that will improve the overall customer experience and lead to greater satisfaction and loyalty among our customers
    • Team effectively with internal and external partners to ensure execution of client account strategy and delivery of target customer outcomes

What We’re Looking For On Your Resume

  • Bachelor’s degree from a competitive university
  • 5+ years experience working in a technical, consulting, or client-facing role
  • Ability to thrive in a fast paced environment, managing multiple projects simultaneously across various customers
  • Demonstrated ability to drive usage with customers in all phases of their adoption journey
  • Hard-working self-starter capable of concurrently running multiple projects in a dynamic environment
  • Comfort in working both autonomously and collaboratively
  • Ability to articulate technical concepts to a non-technical audience
  • Detail-oriented with an ability to prioritize and meet deadlines
  • Familiarity with software and front-end development
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Strong problem-solving skills

What You Should Know About This Team

  • Supportive environment with opportunities to work both autonomously and collaboratively
  • Fun, inviting, and inclusive work environment
  • Team of passionate, kind, and smart people who exemplify what it means to be a team

Our Team’s Favorite Perks and Benefits

  • Work-life integration is deeply important to us - we have frequent office events, team outings, and happy hours
  • Qualtrics Experience Program - $ 1,800 for an experience of your choosing (eligible after a year)
  • Allowances for meals, transportation, groceries, and more
  • We take pride in our office design aiming at fostering creativity
  • We believe in sharing Qualtrics' success which is part of the compensation for all employees

The Qualtrics Hybrid Work Model: Our hybrid work model is elegantly simple: we all gather in the office three days a week; Mondays and Thursdays, plus one day selected by your organizational leader. These purposeful in-person days in thoughtfully designed offices help us do our best work and harness the power of collaboration and innovation. For the rest of the week, work where you want, owning the integration of work and life.

Qualtrics is an equal opportunity employer meaning that all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.

Applicants in the United States of America have rights under Federal Employment Laws: Family & Medical Leave Act , Equal Opportunity Employment , Employee Polygraph Protection Act

Qualtrics is committed to the inclusion of all qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, Qualtrics will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please let your Qualtrics contact/recruiter know.

title: Product Manager, New Games
description:
We're looking for a talented and passionate Product Manager to join Wildlife's New Games team . Wildlife is constantly building and releasing new titles with the goal of bringing fun to billions of people around the world. The company has already surpassed the mark of 4 billion downloads. The New Games Product team is accountable for defining which new games will be produced and building these products in partnership with engineers and artists. These are the products that will drive the company's growth for the following years.

As a Wildlife New Games Product Manager, you will define new game theses to be validated by the executives team, you will also be accountable for the game's vision throughout the development cycle, from prototyping to global launch. You will use player feedback, data analysis and accurate business sense to improve the game's performance.

We know that the work we do has a high impact on our company's success and culture. The right person for this position is curious by nature, and comfortable in a "take the initiative" environment, loves solving problems, and can thrive in a fast and growing business.

What you'll do

  • Using market research, propose new game theses that can be played by millions of people for multiple years
  • Define the new game's vision and product roadmap (adapting it if needed as we gather more data about the product)
  • Design the game's main features and write their specifications
  • In partnership with the game's art leader and the distribution team define the game theme and art style
  • Review game design decisions made by the rest of the team (artists and engineers)
  • Coordinate deliveries within the core team and with related disciplines (engineering, art, distribution, data science);

Você conhece a LDC? A LDC é uma das principais comercializadoras e processadoras global de produtos agrícolas, com um portfólio diversificado, que abrange toda a cadeia de valor, da originação à distribuição. Com atividades no centro da produção agrícola e de alimentos e guiados pelos nossos fortes valores, por um legado rico e uma visão clara, estamos comprometidos em trabalhar por um futuro seguro e sustentável. Estruturada como uma organização matricial de 6 regiões geográficas e 10 plataformas, a LDC está ativa em mais de 100 países e emprega cerca de 15.000 pessoas em todo o mundo. Somos guiados por valores que norteiam todos os públicos em nosso trabalho. A ética e integridade fazem parte de todas as relações de negócio, assim como a humildade, comprometimento e diversidade.

  • Criação, avaliação, melhoramento e acompanhamento de procedimentos técnicos de manutenção mecânica e elétrica;

  • Auxilio na elaboração de planos de manutenção corretiva programada, preventiva, preditiva e melhorias;

  • Auxilio na análise crítica de paradas (diariamente);
  • Auxilio ao PCM na elaboração de indicadores e apresentações;
  • Auxilio ao Coordenador e o PCM na gestão do mininegócio manutenção;
  • Auxilío na fiscalização dos serviços de empresas terceiras;
  • Identificação e programação de serviços de manutenção;
  • Auxilio na elaboração de Projetos de Manutenção (Capex);
  • Realizar pesquisas e levantamento de dados técnicos para criação de controles de estoque e afins;

Qualificações

Conhecimento no Pacote Office

Conhecimento em rotinas e controles administrativos de estoques e compras

Diversidade, Inclusão e Equidade

A diversidade é parte do nosso DNA. A LDC busca sempre criar um ambiente de trabalho diversificado e inclusivo, onde todas as pessoas possam prosperar. Respeitamos e valorizamos talentos de todos os gêneros, idades, raças, etnias, sexualidades, religiões e deficiências. Diversidade é um de nossos valores! Essa oportunidade destina-se também às pessoas com deficiências (PcD).

O valor sustentável está no centro de nosso propósito como empresa.

Somos apaixonados pela criação de valor justo e sustentável, tanto para nossos negócios quanto para outros stakeholders da cadeia de valor: nosso pessoal, nossos parceiros comerciais, as comunidades e o meio ambiente ao nosso redor.
